findings: put uses O_EXCL and fsyncs each file plus parent directory before returning.
Third read compares the same complete raw bytes and all nine file metadata values after persistence.
The closer binds the ack to exact retained FENCE bytes and the original pending receipt descriptor.
The closer enforces action return <= PRE observation <= durability observation < late receipt observation <= POST observation.
A receipt advancing during PRE persistence leaves the failed first fence and produces no durability ack; final_observation cannot retake it.
LATE originals are written only after terminal r6 receipt with joined waitpid, absent group and retained identity; failures after LATE cannot rewrite it.
limitations: Only the specified increment was reviewed; unrelated closer code was not independently re-audited.
Tests use isolated temporary files and process-local BASE/put instrumentation solely for fault injection.
No physical phase, actor, native call, model, provider or phone was exercised.
